activeRc7: RC7 HS03 scopes: interleaved actor scopes on one store; frame and CCall producers drain no window, an actor probe and a threshold drain only their own scope, and a refused decision keeps its committed window
RC7 HS03 scopes: an enclosing transaction owns a flushed window; rollback restores it and commit keeps it, then noise-only and result windows keep exact lastActivity
RC7 HS03 actor successor: a not_reached decision that commits the pending window returns its durable successor, and the actor admits its next window there
